# Signing certificate of the personalDNSfilter APK this tool installs (the F-Droid build whose
# version and sha256 are pinned in lib/cleanup.sh), as hex DER. Android only accepts an adb restore
# for an app when the archive names the certificate that app is signed with.
# Update it together with the APK: unzip -p the.apk 'META-INF/*.RSA' |
#   openssl pkcs7 -inform DER -print_certs | openssl x509 -outform DER | xxd -p | tr -d '\n'
